acceptance: On /result-summaries/, its index pages and a platform and a benchmark summary page, the header's Results link carries the current-page state (aria-current and styling) and no other link does
/results/ pages and docs, blog and landing pages keep their current highlighting
A unit test for surfaceFor covers /result-summaries/ paths and a near-miss path such as /result-summariesx
context:
Noticed 2026-11-06 while delivering PR #118; left out of that PR's scope.

2026-11-07: Done in PR #130 (merge 522d59dbb3). surfaceFor in explorer/src/components/shellModel.ts maps /result-summaries, its subpaths and .html pages to the results surface via a prefix table; near-misses such as /result-summaries-old do not match. website/tests/shell.test.ts covers the entry page, platforms.html, benchmarks.html and a platform and a benchmark page (only Results current), near-misses, and unchanged /results, docs, blog and landing. website/e2e/shell.mjs loads the five summary routes in the built site and requires only Results to carry aria-current=page. The mapping existed only in surfaceFor (header-links.ts re-exports it; SiteHeader and SiteShell both use shellLinks).
description: The site header marks the current surface with surfaceFor() in explorer/src/components/shellModel.ts (line 109). It matches /docs, /blog and /results by path prefix, so the summary pages added under /result-summaries/ (PR #118) get no current surface and the Results link is not highlighted there, although those pages are part of the results surface.
